en.headline: Ventilation duct collapses in Hung Hom Bay Centre carpark, damaging two cars
en.dek: Police said a large duct and concrete fell from the ceiling late Monday night, crushing a Porsche and a Mercedes-Benz with no injuries.
body: Police received a report at about 10:41pm on Monday from a security guard that a section of ceiling concrete, roughly two metres by three metres, had collapsed in the carpark of Hung Hom Bay Centre at 92-112 Baker Street.

Officers found that a large ventilation duct together with concrete had fallen onto two parked cars, a Porsche and a Mercedes-Benz, causing damage. No one was inside the vehicles and no passers-by were nearby, so no injuries were reported.
Police cordoned off the area for investigation and treated the case as one involving a falling object. The carpark appeared aged, with parts of the ceiling covered by canvas.
The incident occurred on the evening of 16 November.

zh.headline: 紅磡灣中心停車場風管塌下壓毀兩車無人受傷
zh.dek: 警方指周一晚約10時41分大型風管連石屎從天花墮下，壓中一輛保時捷及一輛平治，無人受傷。
body: 警方周一晚上約10時41分接獲保安員報案，指紅磡必嘉街92至112號紅磡灣中心停車場內約2米乘3米天花石屎塌下。
警員到場發現一條大型風管連同部分石屎墮下，壓毀兩輛停泊中的私家車，分別為一輛保時捷及一輛平治。事發時車內無人，附近亦無途人，因此無人受傷。
警方封鎖現場調查，並將案件列作高空墮物處理。停車場設施較為老舊，部分天花以帆布遮蓋。
